summary: This note introduces VitalityHub's Comprehensive Health Screenings and Assessments program, a proactive employee wellness initiative meant to give early warning of health risks and a baseline for tracking wellness. It outlines the screening components, shares two employee success stories (Jenna and Mark), and describes a company culture of proactive wellness. Employees are encouraged to contact HR to schedule a screening.
one_line: VitalityHub introduces a proactive employee wellness program of health screenings and assessments, with success stories and instructions to enroll via HR.
key_facts: VitalityHub's Comprehensive Health Screenings and Assessments program is a proactive approach to employee wellness.
The screenings are meant to act as an early warning system for potential health risks and a baseline for tracking each employee's wellness journey.
The screening process includes baseline blood pressure and cholesterol checks and advanced screenings tailored to individual needs.
The program's 'trifecta' is biometric screenings, mental health evaluations, and consultations with healthcare professionals.
Jenna, a project manager, discovered her pre-diabetes status through the program and reversed it with early intervention, personalized nutrition counseling, and regular follow-ups.
Mark, a graphic designer, learned of his risk for heart disease and improved his cardiovascular health through wellness initiatives and fitness programs.
VitalityHub aims to replace the 'waiting for sickness' paradigm with a culture of proactive wellness.
Employees can enroll by contacting the HR department to schedule their Comprehensive Health Screening and Assessment.
VitalityHub states that the health and well-being of team members are cornerstones of personal satisfaction and professional success.
